name: impact-experience
blurb: Experience timeline showing career roles with background images that appear on hover.
description: Full-section component displaying a hardcoded experience timeline. Each item shows company, position, location, industry, tagline, and multi-line description in a grid layout. Background images (Unsplash URLs) fade in on hover of each item. No props — data and styling are baked in.
use_when: Portfolio or about pages showcasing career history or significant projects.
avoid_when: Dynamic data or reusable experience sections; this component has hardcoded content.
a11y: Semantic structure with h2 and section elements. Images are decorative (empty alt). No keyboard navigation beyond link focus.
